description_en: Generates a ticket for passwordless access if you need to share console pages with others without requiring logon or embed them in third-party systems. After generating the ticket by calling CreateTicket, you can construct a passwordless access link
description_zh: 如果您需要将控制台页面免密分享给其他人或者嵌入到第三方系统，可以调用CreateTicket生成票据，然后拼接免密链接
name: CreateTicket

parameters.help_en: The expiration time in seconds for the embedded page URL link. Default value: 86400 (one day). Valid values: 0 to 2592000 (30 days)
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间（秒），即内嵌页面URL链接过期时间，默认86400秒（一天），取值0~2592000秒（30天）
parameters.name: expiration_time

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the access token in seconds, which specifies how long the user can access page APIs. Default value: 86400 (one day). Valid values: 0 to 86400 (one day).
The actual access token expiration time is the minimum value of accessTokenExpirationTime and expirationTime.
If you call this operation by using a Security Token Service (STS) token, the actual access token expiration time is the minimum value of accessTokenExpirationTime, expirationTime, and the STS token expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
访问令牌过期时间（秒），即用户可以访问页面接口的过期时间，默认86400秒（一天），取值0~86400秒（一天）。
访问令牌过期时间是accessTokenExpirationTime、expirationTime的最小值。
若通过STS调用，访问令牌过期时间（即用户可以访问页面接口的时间）是accessTokenExpirationTime、expirationTime、STS过期时间的最小值
parameters.name: access_token_expiration_time
